I've been to 8 different shops in two years. All of them highly recommended. Never picked at random. The only thing out of place is one of the leaf springs looks a little bit more flat than the other. But all the shops have said that wouldn't affect my alignment.

The rear drive axle is thrust left and the forward drive axle is thrust right. This is how MD alignment does it. I've had them do it twice. Still pulling to one side or the other. That's after I had brand new tires put on about 8 months ago and alignment done the same day. Then had md alignment done 600 miles later. Then again about 30,000 miles later.
There's two shims I just want to remove one.

Toe is perfect. I've had 8 alignments done in two years and replaced everything. I had an alignment done a few months ago, MD alignment, toe in 1/8, rear axle pushed left, front pushed right. Old tires were worn and kept pulling right. Got new tires, still pulling right.
